Bug_Details:
Comparison using reference equality instead of value equality Optionals should be compared for value equality using .equals(), and not for
reference equality using == and !=.
Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs in the main method of the OptionalEquality class where optional1 and optional2 are compared using '==' operator instead of the equals() method. This is a common mistake when working with Optional in Java.
